// diagnostic R0801

Jet.RawAccessOutsideProvenance

Raw `{operation}` outside `{gate}`'s storage

What

Raw `{operation}` outside `{gate}`'s storage

Why

The pointer is outside the allocation provenance tracked for the active `#Unsafe` gate ({detail}); runtime evidence never replaces a required static obligation.

Fix

Bound the raw access before it reaches storage — obligation `{obligation}` was not met on this run.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.RawAccessOutsideProvenance: Tests/UI/runtime_r0801.stderr.

Error: Jet.RawAccessOutsideProvenance: Raw `volatile_write` outside `external address must be a live allocation`'s storage
  --> runtime_r0801.jet:10:13, in #Unsafe gate "external address must be a live allocation"
 Why: The pointer is outside the allocation provenance tracked for the active `#Unsafe` gate (no live allocation contains this address); runtime evidence never replaces a required static obligation.
 Fix: Bound the raw access before it reaches storage — obligation `valid_ptr` was not met on this run.
obligation: valid_ptr = false
exit: 70
